Full summary: Drafted the W2 / 2.17.1 breakdown as two plan files: docs/plans/2026-09-08-2.17.0-w2-implementation.md (19 tasks) and docs/plans/2026-09-08-2.17.1-implementation.md (11 tasks); anchors read at HEAD d7860e0
Decisions: Chose two plan files (2.17.0 = W2, 2.17.1 = the pre-decided follow-on) over one combined breakdown — each produces a shippable release with its own review and tag, mirroring the 2.16.1 precedent, and the cross-host plan §5 sequences them as separate trains; Chose to pull the tool-description byte measurement (cross-host plan §4.4, scheduled for W4) forward into W2 as Task 0 — §4.4's own condition is 'baseline recorded before the first J-item description edit', and W2 edits five descriptions (why, search_decisions, query, status, assemble); a black-box tools/list measurement over the built server counts what reaches a client, including surface gating; Chose to read every code anchor myself rather than fan out mapper agents — reads are fast and deterministic, the plan needs verbatim signatures in the author's context, and the previous workflow run lost all 24 agents to the stall detector; a workflow is used only for the plan critique, where independent perspectives add value; Placed createSuperseding last in W2 as the pre-authorized slide candidate (wave-2 response §3.2) with a decidable criterion (review findings > 6 or touching both backends' write sections), and marked the lineage bundle and the empty-result sync caveat as the two items that never move (cross-host plan §6.3); Chose a lazily built claimant map (one get per index entry, only at retired dead-ends, ≤20 hidden rows) for the lineage reverse scan over projecting `supersedes` into DecisionIndexEntry this wave — the projection needs a files-backend index rewrite; recorded as a follow-up with a 1 s dogfood trigger; Chose an unconditional short empty-result sync caveat (measured 33 tokens, under the §6.3 ceiling of 40) over an actionable-only line — in the field's exact topology host B has fetch age < 1 h and behind=0, so a gated caveat would never fire where it matters
Findings: ASM-population (assemble description saying decisions_count is 'the briefing selection, not a scope census') already shipped in 2.16.0 — src/tools/context-tools.ts assemble description; the W2 plan records it as done, no task; None of the W2 symbols exist at HEAD (createSuperseding, lineage_unresolved, superseded_by_inferred, backfill_only, sync.probe, git-sync-state, pointer_loss, unreadable_retained, STORE_UNSERVABLE, decisions_persisted, duplicate_input) — clean slate confirmed by grep before drafting; need: the W2 plan's DD-9 floor value (0.15 vs 0.2) and the J-7 AUTO-SAFE widening are decided by executed evidence at TDD time (dogfood dry-run script, merge-matrix test) — both carry decidable criteria in the plan; Dave's review should confirm the +20% tool-description allowance (A3) and the two-file split
